messages:
Maya (Eng Manager): Quick Q — we're planning to promote Jordan (APAC) mid-cycle from IC4 -> Senior IC (IC5) with a comp adjustment and spot equity. Are there any regional nuances I should know?
Priya (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: Main things: leveling packet + comp change form. For APAC there are extra payroll/tax steps and sometimes mandatory local benefits enrollment windows. Also note approvals may take slightly longer due to committee timezone overlap.
Maya (Eng Manager): Got it. Case details: effective_date requested = 2026-03-15, requested base = SGD 210k (currently SGD 185k). Equity: pro-rated RSU request. Jordan is transitioning from IC4 to IC5 due to project leadership and mentorship responsibilities.
Connor (Compensation): Raw math: that's ~13.5% increase. Since it's >10%, comp committee review required. Please attach market benchmark sources (Radford/Levels.fyi) and a short justification (2-3 bullets) about scope.
Maya (Eng Manager): Will add bullets. Any guidance on communicating to Jordan now?
Priya (People Ops): Don't promise specifics until both committees approve. You can say "promotion under review; expected timeline 3-7 business days." If urgent for retention risk, mark "expedite" in the packet and explain impact.
Nina (Payroll): For Singapore runs: cutoff is 5 business days before pay date for changes to hit the next cycle. If approvals miss cutoff, we can process a retro adjustment in the next run or do an off-cycle payment, but off-cycle requires Finance sign-off and triggers local statutory reporting changes.
Maya (Eng Manager): If comp committee approves after cutoff, will retro pay be taxed differently?
Nina (Payroll): Retro pay is taxed in the period it's paid under local rules; withholding may be different from regular payroll. We'll include a breakdown in the pay slip. Also need to confirm CPF-like contributions where applicable.
Connor (Compensation): Equity: for APAC employees, RSU grant timing often requires extra acceptance steps due to local law. Submit the grant request with the promotion packet so equity team can run both in parallel.
Maya (Eng Manager): Any HRIS quirks? Jordan was onboarded via contractor record two years ago and then converted; current profile is full employee.
Priya (People Ops): For promotions you should update job profile (don't create a new employee). But double-check the employee's tax residency field and bank details. If any historic contractor records clobbered fields, fix those first.
Maya (Eng Manager): Ok. I'm worried about upward band crossing; do we need to reclass headcount?
Connor (Compensation): If promotion crosses bands or budget owners change, include cost center confirmation. For headcount it's an "existing" role change. If it creates a new manager role then we do a headcount adjustment.
Maya (Eng Manager): I submitted leveling packet and comp form with benchmarking and flagged expedite (critical IC on retention).
Priya (People Ops): Received. Routing to leveling committee now. Note: leveling committee will confirm band mapping and whether this is an IC level change (not a people manager). Expect 1-3 business days.
Connor (Compensation): Quick checklist for you: attach market data, the 2-3 bullet justification, budget code, and whether you want the effective_date to be retroactive. Also confirm whether Jordan should receive a pro-rated RSU grant immediately or wait for next cadence.
Maya (Eng Manager): Requesting effective_date = 2026-03-15 and pro-rated RSU now. Budget code ENG-APAC-08.
Nina (Payroll): FYI for APAC we also need local tax ID and bank confirmation before payroll can accept change. Please ensure Jordan has submitted those in the HR portal.
Maya (Eng Manager): I'll nudge Jordan to confirm bank and tax ID.
Priya (People Ops): Leveling committee approved the level change to IC5. Passing to comp committee for >10% increase. ETA comp committee 24 hours.
Connor (Compensation): Comp committee approved the $210k base and pro-rated RSU. Priya, please prepare the official comp letter and equity paperwork. Nina, watch payroll cutoff for SGD run.
Nina (Payroll): Noted. If comp approval comes after cutoff we'll include retro adjustment in next run. If you need off-cycle, Connor/Priya please confirm cost owner.
Maya (Eng Manager): Communicated to Jordan as "approved, docs being processed". Thanks all.
Priya (People Ops): Final admin: attach promotion confirmation email template when ready and note whether manager will send. Also archive the packet in the employee file for audit. Closing thread once docs sent. :white_check_mark:
